claims.text: Indiscriminately using world knowledge from LLMs causes significant damage to OOD detection due to LLM hallucinations.
Selective generation from LLMs enables the effective application of world knowledge to enhance multi-modal OOD detection.
A consistency-based uncertainty calibration method can estimate the confidence score of each LLM generation.
Extracting visual objects from images allows better utilization of LLM world knowledge in multi-modal OOD detection.

evidence.description: Analysis by the authors observed catastrophic damage to OOD detection when indiscriminately using world knowledge due to LLM hallucinations.
Proposed selective generation framework to apply LLM world knowledge safely for OOD detection.
Introduction of consistency-based uncertainty calibration specifically designed to estimate confidence scores for generations.
Extraction of visual objects from each image to complement and capitalize on contextual world knowledge.

methodologies.name: Selective LLM Generation with Consistency-Based Uncertainty Calibration
methodologies.description: A multi-modal OOD detection framework using selective generation from LLMs, consistency-based uncertainty calibration, and image object extraction.

limitations.text: Indiscriminate use of LLM world knowledge degrades OOD detection performance due to hallucinations.
